{{Top|leg}}
'''Mitraela''' was the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Separatist War]], when the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] fought to overthrow the [[Ord Mantell Central Authority]]. Mitraela lived and worked in the [[Government House (Fort Garnik)|Government House]] in [[Fort Garnik]].
